data.title: Popconfirm
data.tagline: Ask for confirmation next to the action that caused it
data.description: A popconfirm is a small confirmation panel anchored to a button or link. It works for a simple, local action with a short explanation. Use a Modal when the risk is high, the explanation is longer, or more information must be entered.

use: Ask a short yes-or-no question in context
avoid: Confirm a high-risk action with too little explanation
Use it for a form or several decisions
Place it where the triggering control may move away
Ask for confirmation on harmless, easily reversible actions

lessonPractice.title: Archiving a project removes it from the team view immediately, and restoring it requires the archive list. What confirmation fits?

options.label: Use a Popconfirm near the trigger, explaining impact with Archive and Cancel
options.feedback: Correct. A single, reversible but consequential immediate action fits nearby confirmation.

options.label: Open a full Modal with many settings for every archive
options.feedback: A full dialog makes a simple nearby decision unnecessarily heavy.

options.label: Skip confirmation because it can be restored
options.feedback: Reversible does not mean consequence-free; people still need to confirm the target and result.

data.agentPrompt: Use a Popconfirm beside project Archive. Name the project and state that the team will no longer see it by default, with Cancel. Test cancel and confirm: cancel must not change data; confirm must update the list and leave a recovery path.
